# SPEC 900 — Fixture spec (trace-check self-host)

**Status:** fixture. **Prefix:** FIX.

## 1. Implemented section

**FIX-1** A fixture requirement MUST be cited by a test when its section is implemented.

**FIX-2** A fixture MAY carry clauses that are not MUSTs; these never require a citation.

## 2. Unimplemented section

**FIX-3** Requirements in a section outside the scope file MUST NOT be reported as missing.

```
**FIX-9** IDs inside code fences MUST be ignored by the parser.
```
